claim_boundary: training of a frozen recipe on retained fit-split captures; no statistic, no ranking, no held-out access; Gate B is the test

data.anchors: per level: E99 batch-1 parse (wlc.encode_carrier) of the decision frame, shot frame 0 of its first complete candidate in suffix order, under deterministic_scoring()
data.carriers: E99 (the frozen #99 spatial slot parser, s99.load_adapter(s99.OUTPUT, 'E')) parse of every observation 0..min(last, 285), s99.carriers_for (prior position - 1)

excluded.issue-77 N1 lineages: the old fit split (exposed by #112 selection); replaced by the new split
excluded.issue110-fit: the #104 fit_merge pools the #110 normal fit sides with #109 fit, but the Gate-B recipe fixes the E99 encoder, whose 18-slot contract v1 covers the #110 normal cells on only 25 of 40 templates (#110 doc); those levels need the contract-v2 encoder of the #107 track

data.labels: s99.shot_labels (the #99 micro relations and macro labels per observed position)
data.long_windows: v3 LONG starts 0, 15, 30, 45, 60 below the shot's last position
data.ranking_cells: every fit level x inventory in (grid 16, angle 13) whose verdict-bearing candidates hold both a pig removal and a failure (t96.mixed); candidates in inventory-ordinal order, padded to 20; z0 the level anchor; actions the inventory actions
data.shot_order: families, roster order, candidate suffix order (c00..c28); complete branches only
data.split: #109 fit split (issue-109-sealed-cohort-v1, splits.fit: 240 levels per family, families ['type010103', 'type010105']), captured by the #104 campaign stream issue109-fit (capture_pipeline_v2, #113 window rule, Mesa 26.1.2 renderer)
data.verdicts: engine pig-removal verdict of every complete issue109-fit branch from the #104 campaign report (branches.json, #85 channel); rows of other streams are dropped at load
data.windows: s99.windows: starts 0..225 step 15 below the shot's last position, 60 transitions, terminal padding; stored as position indices into the carriers and labels (IndexedTrainData), equal to the materialized v3 window tensors (smoke)

decision_rule.handoff: Gate-B handoff ready (supported) iff G1 holds and the Gate-B unit and C* each keep at least one usable seed; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.usable_checkpoint: a member is usable at Gate B iff it is complete (G2) and does not end in an excursion (G3); an unusable member is a typed terminal failure (retired / final_checkpoint_excursion), never retried or replaced

disclosure: Known before the freeze: every #112 v1/v2/v3 and #117 result, the #104 campaign accounting and its mixed-verdict yield per level type (fit grid 365 / 480, angle 314 / 480). The recipe keeps the #77 update budget of 9000 updates although the new split holds about 19x the v3 windows and 25x its ranking cells; changing it would be a new version. Hardware: 4 x RTX 5090 (the #85 single-RTX-3090 gate is carried as one GPU per member). The SERVER_SETUP path rewrite changed bytes of #77/#96 plans; inputs here bind the current bytes. An external vLLM job used the GPUs while the fit stream was captured (no effect on 160/160 replays, #104).

guards.G1_isolation: every training shot, long window and ranking cell belongs to a complete branch of a #109 fit-roster level in stream issue109-fit; every ranking-cell action equals its shot's executed action
guards.G2_stability: every member reached 9000 updates without retirement and skipped at most 45
guards.G3_end_state: #117 end-state rule, declared before training: a member ends in an excursion when, for some request, the median #77 local loss of its last 3 updates of that request exceeds 5 x the median of that request's updates in [0.6 n, 0.95 n); the first spike is the first of its last 500 updates with a pre-clip norm above 1000

prohibited: reading any evaluation-split, policy-split or #110 capture
changing the recipe, the units, the data rule or a guard after the freeze
retrying or replacing a failed member
question: train the frozen #112 v3 Gate-B unit (LC : F-15-macro, hybrid, E99) and its pre-declared matched baseline C* (LC : C-F-15, continuous) on the #109 fit split captured by the #104 campaign, and hand the checkpoints to Gate B

recipe.definition: #77 recipe + long-horizon supervision + decision-contrastive loss (v3: truncated back-propagation every 45 transitions, skip-on-nonfinite with retirement after 10 consecutive skips)
recipe.implementation: scripts.run_decision_dynamics_retrain.implementation(): a private copy of the v1 runner with the v3 arms, loss constants, SkippingEnsemble (patience 10) and truncated recursion (45) taken from versions.implementation(3); train_group is the v1 function, unchanged

training.execution: members of one (arm, family) are trained in lock-step groups by a vmapped, torch.compile'd transition (training process only; autotuning allowed)
training.local_loss: #74/#77 loss (run_issue_74_matched_dynamics.loss_for) in masked form (decision_dynamics.local_loss) on the #99 windows: starts 0..225 step 15, 60 transitions, terminal padding masked; batch of 64 windows sampled uniformly with replacement from the member's pool by torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)

long_horizon.definition: windows at starts 0, 15, 30, 45, 60 of every fit shot (start below the shot's last position); the step's pair is unrolled horizon // delta transitions; loss = mean over visited positions of row-mean carrier MSE + 0.01 x the #77 carrier-bound penalty; horizon = min(225, 60 + 15 x floor(update / 500))
long_horizon.targets: the E99 parsed carrier at every visited position start + j * delta, terminal absorption past the shot's last frame

training.matched: every arm: same architectures and parameter counts, same 9000 updates of 64 #77 windows

ranking.cost: tie_free (scoring_harness.tie_free on tensors): pig presence - 0.1 x pig-slot center displacement between the anchor carrier and the rollout endpoint at 225
ranking.definition: per update 2 mixed fit-lineage cells (member x inventory, sampled uniformly with replacement from the member's pool); every verdict-bearing candidate action is rolled out with the step's pair from the member's E99 anchor to 225; loss = mean over cells of the mean over (success, failure) pairs of softplus((cost_success - cost_failure) / 0.1); weight 0.1 x ramp, ramp 0 before update 1000 and linear to 1 by update 2000
ranking.verdict_source: fit-lineage inventory executions only (#93 grid/offset, #94 power, #87/#89 angle oracle verdicts); no held-out verdict is read

training.schedule: PAIRS[step % 9]; the continuous family uses the same horizon
training.update: one AdamW over stacked member parameters (elementwise, so per member); per-member gradient clipping to grad_clip; a member with a nonfinite loss or gradient norm is retired at that update (typed terminal failure, never scored)

recipe.unchanged: losses, weights, curriculum, ramp, truncation, skip rule, optimizer, batch sizes, 9000 updates, initialization, seeds, encoder

version_spec.change: truncated back-propagation: the long-horizon and ranking recursions are detached after every 45 transitions (Delta = 5 and 15 unchanged; Delta = 1 in 45-frame gradient segments); a nonfinite update is skipped per member (parameters and AdamW moments untouched), and a member is retired only after 10 consecutive skips
version_spec.diagnosis: v1 retired 28/312 members (L 5/78, LC 23/78, B and C 0), every one on a Delta = 1 update at curriculum horizon >= 165. An instrumented replay of LC/continuous fold 006 seed 20260909 measured per-term gradient norms on Delta = 1 updates of up to 2.2e3 (long-horizon) and 1.1e4 (ranking) against at most 1.2 (#77 local): exploding gradients through up to 225 recursive transitions; an overflow retires the member. No Delta = 5 update (45 recursive transitions) of any of the 312 members was nonfinite.

role: retrain of the frozen #112 v3 recipe on the #104 fit split (the Gate-B checkpoints); no selection, no scoring, no statistic

smoke_evidence.reading: infrastructure assertions only; nothing kept; no statistic; no verdict read

training.execution: one member per train_group call, torch.compile'd vmapped transition; groups spread over the 4 GPUs (one process per GPU); training process only
training.folds: fold 'all' only (every fit level); no leave-one-out folds: nothing is selected
training.logging: every update: the #77 local loss, the pre-clip gradient norm and the skip flag per member (values only)

c_star.source: v3 compute.json baseline_contrast.c_star (the largest-S continuous unit)
